patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Sellfy's shape. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage: Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management; Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs; Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce..
- Company-size focus: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise) vs Sellfy (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management vs Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace.
- Researched limits: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Sellfy — none listed.

Limitations — Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install; Sellfy: —.

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Avoid Salesforce Commerce Cloud if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i) · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need Salesforce Commerce Cloud's motion (Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent qu)
